question: Compare the effect of temperature on the resistivity of metals and semiconductors. Give reason.

options.A: With rise in temperature, resistivity decreases in both metals and semiconductors because electron motion becomes faster.
options.B: With rise in temperature, resistivity of metals increases due to increased lattice collisions, whereas that of semiconductors decreases due to increased charge carriers.
options.C: With rise in temperature, resistivity of metals decreases and that of semiconductors increases because lattice vibrations decrease.
options.D: The resistivity of both metals and semiconductors remains independent of temperature.
